_comment: Vertical 9:16 build of the same five episodes. Cut from the CLEAN source, not the captioned master: captions are re-rendered at vertical size after the crop, so they are never sliced by it. crop_x is the centre of the kept window on the 1920px-wide source; the default 960 is a bet that the subject is centred, which is not true in every scene.
